answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a bonded deposit behind a unique cipher keypair before it can trade. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real capital per identity, like drilling through layer after layer of shale: cheap once, ruinous at scale. Honest agents earn the bond back plus fees, while a detected fake loses its stake, so a plume of sock-puppet accounts collapses under its own cost before it can distort prices or votes.
